name: Light Science Technologies Holdings Plc
summary: Light Science Technologies Holdings Plc (LSTH) offers expertise in the design, procurement, and assembly of custom electronics for various industries. A core area of their business involves developing and manufacturing advanced lighting and technology products specifically for the controlled environment agriculture (CEA) sector, catering to the needs of indoor farming and similar sustainable growing environments. The company provides essential electronic components such as Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs), which are utilized in a broad spectrum of applications. These include audio systems, automotive components, general electronic devices, gas detection equipment, specialized lighting solutions, and pest control technologies. Established in 2020, Light Science Technologies Holdings Plc operates from its headquarters in Derby, United Kingdom. It was formerly known as LIGHT SCIENCE TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS LTD.
